atoms.b: Rhythm is also an important part of poetry. In poetry, rhythm emphasises certain words or syllables. Emphasis can change the meaning of a poem. Rhythm also helps a poem flow and can be noticed when reading a poem out loud. Some famous poets, like John Cooper Clarke, perform their poetry with live music.

instruction.text: Listen and read along to the first stanza again.

example.a:
Once there was an elephant,
Who tried to use the telephant.
No! No! I mean an elephone,
Who tried to use the telephone-
(Dear me! I am not certain quite
That even now I’ve got it right.)
